title: Density of Hermite polynomials
statement: For every dimension $n$, the linear span in $L^2( br^n, gamma_n)$ of the multivariate normalized Hermite functions is dense, where $ gamma_n$ is the product of $n$ standard Gaussian probability measures.
hypotheses_covered: Dimension $n$ is a natural number, with no further restriction.
